charge_port.notes: Green Car Reports: 2017 Focus Electric offers DC fast charging as standard over the CCS connector (US article). Canada not separately checked; the 2017 CA car is the same hardware.

supercharger_access.notes: InsideEVs 2026 list explicitly excludes the Ford Focus Electric (Ford adapters cover E-Transit, Mustang Mach-E, F-150 Lightning only).

wheels.notes: Only trim: 17 in aluminum wheels, P225/50R17 (Cars.com 2018 page). Source is a US page; Canadian trim assumed the same.
